resources.string: Works offline. Your documents never leave your phone.
Turn photos of documents into a clean PDF
Scan pages or pick photos. Folio crops and cleans them, and helps you fit upload size limits.
Your documents never leave your phone

Folio has no internet access, no account, no ads and no tracking. Everything happens on your phone, and Folio doesn\'t back up your documents to any cloud. When you share or save a file to another app, that app receives it.
You can add up to %1$d pages per document.
